resources.string:
Flow Clone uses Accessibility to notice when your keyboard is open, show the dictation bubble, read up to 500 characters around the cursor so the transcript fits what you already wrote, and type the transcript into the focused text field.

Everything stays on this phone: the app has no internet permission, and speech recognition runs locally.

Flow Clone never reads or types into password, PIN, number or phone fields, and it stays hidden in banking and payment apps and in apps you exclude.
